query:
SELECT t.id, t.name
                 FROM tags t
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM manifestation_tags mt
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.id = mt.manifestation_id
                         WHERE mt.tag_id = t.id
                      )
                  AND immutable_unaccent(t.name) ILIKE immutable_unaccent($1 || '%')
                ORDER BY t.name ASC
                LIMIT $2
